items.problem: UWP in-process background tasks (BackgroundTaskBuilder with TaskEntryPoint omitted + App.OnBackgroundActivated) were ported verbatim; Scenarios 3 & 4 Run controls are silently dead because WinUI 3's Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no OnBackgroundActivated.
items.evidence: notes/skill-defects.json item 1; Scenario3_BackgroundWatcher.xaml.cs:165-194; App.xaml.cs has no OnBackgroundActivated; migration-score.json scenarios 3 & 4 = partial (dead Run).
items.root_cause: The in-process background-task activation model does not exist in WinUI 3; registration fails with an HRESULT the UWP sample's narrow catch misses and the async void handler swallows.
items.change: Added validator check 5d to Validate-UwpMigration.ps1: FAIL when retained code builds a BackgroundTaskBuilder with no TaskEntryPoint assignment (in-process model) and no OnBackgroundActivated handler exists. Instructs converting to the out-of-process model (set a string TaskEntryPoint). Complements existing check 5c (which only asserts extension presence and passed here).
items.expected_effect: Agent's 'validator must PASS' loop now catches in-process background-task migrations before declaring done, forcing conversion to the dispatchable out-of-process model.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-running Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 on the current app emits '[FAIL] ... IN-PROCESS background task ... no OnBackgroundActivated'; after the agent sets TaskEntryPoint the check PASSes and requirements 3 & 4 go partial->pass.

items.problem: The skill's Background Tasks guidance documents only the out-of-process model, so the agent had no signal that the in-process variant is unsupported in WinUI 3, and that the UWP sample's HRESULT-specific Register() catch is too narrow.
items.evidence: notes/skill-defects.json + skill-coverage-gaps.json; MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Background Tasks previously covered only string-TaskEntryPoint tasks.
items.root_cause: Missing documentation of the in-process model and of the WinUI-specific registration-failure HRESULT behavior.
items.change: Added an 'In-process tasks do NOT port' paragraph (with a convert-to-out-of-process code snippet) to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md > Background Tasks, and broadened the existing 'surface the failure' item to warn that the UWP HRESULT-specific catch (e.g. E_DEVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE) misses the WinUI failure — use catch(Exception), keep RequestAccessAsync inside the guard, always NotifyUser.
items.expected_effect: When the validator FAILs (item 1) or the agent reads the pattern, it has an actionable, general fix rather than re-shipping a dead control.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run the migrated background handlers set a string TaskEntryPoint and use a broad catch that NotifyUser's a status; parity Run invoke on Scenarios 3 & 4 produces a visible status change (winui_responded=true).
